facts.fact: 十四个月后：Logan代表美国队打加拿大争金牌
facts.anchor: Logan was playing for Team USA in a contentious gold medal matchup with Team Canada.

facts.fact: 看台三人组：Carson喊"我的女孩"、Levi喊"我妹"、Alan喊"我弟媳"

facts.anchor: his wedding band glinting from his finger.

facts.fact: 过去一年：Levi与Carson重新成为朋友
facts.anchor: Over the past year, Levi and I had become friends again

facts.fact: 与父母仍未和解，但 Meredith 已复联
facts.anchor: I still hadn’t talked to my parents, but Logan had encouraged me to reach out to my sister
Meredith was planning to come out to LA next summer after she turned eighteen.

facts.fact: 他为妹妹存了大学学费
facts.anchor: I had money set aside for her to go to college

facts.fact: 进球后与老队友Annika相拥——旧队情未断
facts.anchor: the crowd went wild. Logan celebrated with her teammates, rallying around Annika.

facts.fact: 金牌后：她是最受赞誉、最高薪的女冰球员之一
facts.anchor: She was one of the most decorated and highly paid female hockey players.

facts.fact: 她的focus仍在为女性开拓空间
facts.anchor: her focus was on improving her skills and creating more opportunities for women in sports

facts.fact: 奥运村限宿的应对：滑雪缆车/室友回来前/黑暗走廊
facts.anchor: We’d definitely pushed some boundaries—on a ski lift, in my room before my roommate returned, in a darkened hallway.

facts.fact: 三人合照：Levi与Carson分立两侧——友谊强于以往
facts.anchor: Levi and me flanking his sister, our friendship stronger than ever.

facts.fact: 章末：家人比冰球更重要
facts.anchor: A family who loved each other even more than hockey.

facts.fact: 全书末句：宽恕可能、爱无条件
facts.anchor: A family where forgiveness was possible and love was unconditional.
